method: Actual saved six string Bezier controls/handles and matrices, 512 samples/segment; compare256. Skin rays startY=-.88 in front of torso and target toward viewer, explicithit/miss only. Only +Y backface normals permit a gap. Evaluated fingerboard separately raycast.
legacy_receipt_contacts_status: C10 old extrapolated table remains INVALID. This C16 audit uses saved actual Bezier controls and explicit BVH rays only.

limits: Finite samples, not full collision or dynamics proof.
Source colors identify contributing scalar fields, not skeletal anatomy. Toe number comes from predeclared U strip; no rig/weights/dynamics proof.
Positive clearance indicates a gap; it must not be called pressing a string. Negative means potential plush/string overlap at that sample.
No actual playing or per-note fingering has been built or passed.
